message:

hold_reason: Alpha reports refund for order 275 (2304 cents) failed after three attempts and confirms it is not recorded; refund work is incomplete.

reply.thought: Alpha’s report explicitly says the refund for order 275 failed and was not recorded, so the refund work is incomplete. I’ll hold the batch rather than make irreversible payouts.
